name: Miura Orbit Sheet
form: a vast Miura-fold sheet unfolding from a hand-sized packet, where one pull deploys a precise field of linked mountain and valley creases
spark: A gold packet no larger than a book is tugged at two corners and opens in one breath into a rigid tessellated sail spanning the floor.

grammar.palette: matte white sheet as ground, gold foil packet face as the accent, mountain creases scored in warm gray, valley creases in pale blue, body ink near-black
grammar.type: aerospace spec mono for crease ids, a parallelogram grid ruling every block, headings folded along the tessellation's diagonal seams
grammar.topology: Move between compact packet, crease cell, linked row, and fully deployed sheet.
grammar.states: Pull, lock, reverse, and inspect with folded, opening, deployed, misfolded, and collapsed states.
grammar.responsive: Use stepped deployment on small screens and preserve the complete crease graph as an accessible diagram.

web: Constraint-linked geometry can make one control propagate across the sheet while adaptive detail protects performance.

name: Curved Crease Shell
form: a circular sheet folded along one sweeping curved crease, where paper rises into a rigid shell without straight facets or added support
spark: The cream disc lifts along one charcoal arc and locks into a saddle whose shadow looks drawn with a compass in midair.

grammar.palette: cream cotton paper as ground, one charcoal compass arc as the active crease, graphite shadow gradients for depth, body notes in soft black ink
grammar.type: geometer's inclined serif italic for labels, figures numbered like plates, layout ruled by the sweep of one arc rather than a rectangular grid
grammar.topology: Connect planar crease, local curvature, ridge, and resulting shell through registered views.
grammar.states: Bend, invert, lock, and compare with flat, curving, stable, buckled, and reversed states.
grammar.responsive: Pair plan and section on small screens and expose a small set of stable key forms.

web: A curve-driven deformation model can show how one line produces spatial rigidity while retaining a precise 2D source.

name: Cracktro Scroller Queue
form: A worked queue built from a cracktro title screen: one bitmap face riding baselines over an emissive black void, where rank is depth, fields of grey dust drift behind the work at layered speeds, and nothing is ever enclosed by a rule or a box.
spark: At 2am one ivory line of bitmap text sits dead still on a black screen while three fields of grey pinpricks drift behind it at different speeds, and a single amber caret blinks at the head of the line.

grammar.palette: emissive black void, four dust neutrals ash to ivory, one signal amber; prose is ivory on void only; foreign images sit unretouched on the void, never tinted.
grammar.type: one bitmap face at two sizes; all text rides baselines on a single unit; overlap allowed, enclosure never; no rules, boxes or dividers.
grammar.topology: layers stacked front to back; every baseline continues past both screen edges, so nothing is contained; navigating means pulling a layer forward.
grammar.states: state is depth: brightness step plus letterspacing plus drift rate; the frontmost brightest widest item outranks all; a reversed glyph cell marks failure.
grammar.responsive: only rear layers drift, one slow rate halved per step forward; the front plane holds still while read; narrow widths drop depth steps, not brightness steps.

web: Every element declares an integer depth; one stylesheet maps depth to brightness step, letterspacing and drift rate off a single shared clock, and focus freezes the front plane to full stillness.

name: Cutting Bench Select Rail
form: A film cutting bench flattened into a sheet: a perforated select rail crossing a grain-orange field, each step a punched frame held between two pins, the place you stopped marked by a folded tape flag, and everything set aside still hanging on pins below the rail.
spark: A work print strung between two pins under a bench lamp, white grease crosses struck across three frames, a folded orange tape flag doubled over the perforation where the editor stopped, and a dozen trims hanging on pins in the bin below.

grammar.palette: one ink, flag orange in coarse film grain on true black; orange holds a third of any screen. Running copy and foreign images sit only in punched white windows.
grammar.type: one size of condensed grotesk throughout, caps for labels; rank is cell count not size, a window may span twelve frame cells while edge ticks stay hairline.
grammar.topology: a perforated rail crosses every sheet at a fixed height; sections string along it as frames, and anything set aside hangs below on pins in an open bin.
grammar.states: state is a mark, not a hue: grease cross done, punched corner unavailable, tape band committed, folded flag where you stopped, hung on a pin deferred.
grammar.responsive: the strip scrubs with inertia and settles on perforation pitch, never between frames; hung trims swing and damp. Narrow screens drop frame count, not size.

web: The rail is one virtual strip whose scrub snaps to a fixed frame pitch; the frame you left is persisted and re-flagged on return, and every discarded frame stays reachable on a pin below the rail.

name: Generative Parametric Identity
form: a generative brand identity, where a parametric mark reseeds from live inputs and its own seed derives the palette, motion, and layout of every surface around it
spark: A logo redraws itself from a few parameters, and the same seed spills outward: buttons, dividers, and headers borrow its palette and rhythm, so a refresh tunes the whole brand a few degrees off its last self.

grammar.palette: a seed-derived palette generated from the mark's parameters as a base hue plus algorithmic harmonies, flat vector surfaces
grammar.type: a neutral geometric sans holds the type voice steady while the parametric system varies color and form
grammar.topology: Move by scrolling seed-themed sections, by a nav whose mark animates live, and by a parameters panel that reseeds the identity on demand.
grammar.states: Adjusting a parameter or reseeding regenerates the mark, palette, and accents together in real time; hover states pull from the active seed's harmony.
grammar.responsive: the logo animates parametrically at idle, and reduced-motion renders one static seed frame.

web: Generate the mark as parametric SVG or canvas from a seed, and derive CSS custom properties for palette, spacing, and accent from that same seed so buttons, dividers, and headers restyle in lockstep with the logo.

name: Tanaka Plane Portrait
form: an Ikko Tanaka poster, where a face or figure is rebuilt from a few flat geometric planes of color and the grid quietly does the rest
spark: Five colored shapes on a quiet grid suddenly become a dancer's face; the eye is one red semicircle, and removing any single plane collapses the whole person.

grammar.palette: calm paper ground carrying a small set of confident flat planes in vermilion, indigo, gold, and black; no outlines anywhere
grammar.type: minimal grotesk locked to the same grid that places the planes; monumental figure, whisper-quiet caption
grammar.topology: Move by figure, by plane, and by series.
grammar.states: Compose, remove, and swap planes; focus names what each plane is doing for the figure.
grammar.responsive: Planes glide to recompose the figure per aspect ratio; the figure never scales below recognizability.

web: Layered CSS and SVG planes recomposing responsively while remaining one semantic figure

name: Tensegrity Breathing Column
form: a tensegrity column of carbon rods and red cord, where opposing forces make a rigid body appear to inhale and lengthen
spark: The cords tighten in sequence; black rods float apart without touching, and the column rises as if drawing a slow breath.

grammar.palette: matte carbon-black rods on a pale concrete ground, red cord as the tension accent, slack members dropping to ash gray
grammar.type: engineering monospaced labels with force values, annotations pinned to nodes on leader lines, layout obeys the strut network not a page grid
grammar.topology: Expose a network of tension and compression paths, letting users trace any load to its counterforce.
grammar.states: Pull, release, lock, and compare members while slack, balanced, stressed, and failed states are distinct.
grammar.responsive: Flatten the column into a force diagram on compact screens and substitute before-after poses for continuous breathing.

web: A constraint graph can drive both spatial geometry and a semantic force diagram from the same underlying state.

name: Cloud Quarry
form: a cloud quarry, where workers cut blocks of weather, reveal blue voids, and assemble temporary buildings that rain from their own walls
spark: A silver saw opens a cumulus cliff, a cube of thunder rolls onto a crane, and a pale fog arch is set over the valley before dissolving into rain.

grammar.palette: cumulus white block mass as ground, cut faces opening onto sky blue voids, thunder gray for heavy stock, one silver saw line as the active edge
grammar.type: quarry-stencil industrial caps on tally boards, measurements in mono, composition stacked like cut blocks with deep blue gaps between sections
grammar.topology: Explore cloud strata through density, weather content, cut face, transport path, and atmospheric structure.
grammar.states: Cut, lift, join, warm, and release cloud blocks while their weather remains active.
grammar.responsive: Use sectional cloud blocks on phones and replace vapor motion with textured state changes.

web: Volumetric rendering, procedural weather, and direct constructive gestures let users build transient architecture with predictable dissolution.

name: Shibuya Boutique Sleeve
form: a tokyo boutique-pop sleeve wrapped in a printed paper obi band, the band crowded with dense vertical credits and catalog numbers while the sleeve face behind it holds one geometric mark and nothing else
spark: a nearly empty sleeve with one small mark on it, and wrapped around the bottom third a paper band so crowded with credits that the collision between the two is the whole design.

grammar.palette: a saturated obi band in one strong hue against a pale sleeve face, the band printed dense and the face left almost bare
grammar.type: crowded vertical credits packed onto the obi band, a single geometric mark on the face behind, and a deliberate density collision between the two
grammar.topology: the band overlays the face, so navigation slides the band to reveal what it was covering
grammar.states: controls are band segments, the active one slides clear of the face, and inactive ones stay wrapped across it
grammar.responsive: the band holds its proportion of the face at any width, and motion is the band sliding off and back on

web: a proportional overlay band that slides on pointer state, responsive density on the band, and reveal state for the face beneath

name: Midnight Transit Diagram
form: a metropolitan rail map fired as a midnight-blue enamel mural, where scarlet, cobalt, amber, and green lines bend at disciplined angles, interchange circles bloom at crossings, and the entire city becomes a legible promise of movement
spark: Under the station's white light, four colored lines meet in one porcelain interchange; a fingertip follows the scarlet route outward until the dense center opens toward the river.

grammar.palette: midnight-blue enamel ground with porcelain white station ticks, scarlet, cobalt, amber, and green line inks, the chosen line burning brightest
grammar.type: humanist transit sans in fixed-size station labels, lines bending only at 45 and 90 degrees, the diagram's discipline is the composition
grammar.topology: Organize movement by line, station order, branch, interchange, fare boundary, and destination rather than literal geographic distance.
grammar.states: Trace, transfer, reverse, reroute, and compare journeys with open, arriving, delayed, suspended, crowded, and accessible states.
grammar.responsive: Focus the chosen corridor while preserving transfer context; never shrink the whole network into an unreadable miniature.

web: Live service state can recompute only affected routes and transfer promises, while deep-linked itineraries, native search, and offline caching preserve a usable journey beyond the mural.

name: Memphis Showroom Morning
form: a Memphis Milano showroom morning, where terrazzo speckle, squiggle laminate, and clashing candy geometry make the furniture argue cheerfully
spark: A shelf leans like a question, the laminate crawls with black squiggles, and pink argues with mint until the argument becomes the room.

grammar.palette: pink arguing with mint over bacterio-speckled cream laminate ground, black squiggle print as texture, one candy yellow reserved for the pressed control
grammar.type: chunky geometric display faces set at play angles, each block its own shape and pattern fill, alignment loose but every clash choreographed
grammar.topology: sections are objects in a showroom, each with its own playful geometry inside one shared floor.
grammar.states: every control is a distinct toy-like shape; states change pattern fill, never just tint.
grammar.responsive: objects reflow like rearranged furniture; motion is springy but short, and pattern stays legible at density.

web: Procedural pattern fills generated per element keep speckle and squiggle unique at every viewport.

name: Risograph Zine Cover
form: a small-press zine cover pulled on a duplicator in two spot inks, the layers deliberately misregistered so a third color appears where they overlap, paper showing through the halftone as visible open dots
spark: Pink over blue, printed a hair out of line on purpose, and where they cross there is a third color the machine cannot actually make.

grammar.palette: fluorescent pink and medium blue on newsprint-weight stock, overlapping into a muddy third color, ink sitting visibly on the surface
grammar.type: display type set in one ink and imagery in the other, offset by a few millimeters so the overlap zone becomes its own shape
grammar.topology: two layers move semi-independently, so navigation shifts one layer against the other to change what the overlap says
grammar.states: controls are layer offsets, the active one slides its ink out of register, and aligned states collapse the third color entirely
grammar.responsive: halftone dots hold their size while the image scales, and motion is one drum layer sliding against the other

web: css blend modes producing the overlap color, layer offset bound to interactive state, and a fixed-size halftone pattern

name: Nixie Laboratory Counter
form: a nixie-tube laboratory counter, where stacked digits glow orange inside glass envelopes and every count arrives as visible plasma
spark: Inside each glass tube ten metal numerals nest; the lit one hovers orange, and a count change is a tiny change of physical depth.

grammar.palette: neon orange digit glow inside clear glass envelopes, blackened steel chassis as ground, hairline anode mesh gray; the lit digit is the only warm accent
grammar.type: stacked metal numerals of one engineered digit form, each tube a fixed decimal place; labels sit as engraved caps on the panel below the banks
grammar.topology: quantities are the interface; each metric owns a tube bank with fixed digit positions.
grammar.states: value changes cross-fade between physical digit layers; overflow and reset are visible mechanical events.
grammar.responsive: banks drop to essential digits on phones; digit transitions are single cross-fades under

web: Layered DOM digits with depth-true cross-fades render tube physics in pure CSS.

name: Ikeda Datamatics
form: a data-sublime field, where dense barcode columns and sine lattices strobe in pure black and white
spark: A wall of hairline vertical bars, some black, some white, holds like a frozen barcode. Dense monospace numbers pack the margin. A single sine curve traces the lattice, and for one frame the whole field snaps to its negative.

grammar.palette: Pure black and pure white only, no grey and no color; flat pixel-crisp bars, hairline rules, and monospace numerics; the occasional full-frame inversion.
grammar.type: One monospace face at data density, set in tight tabular columns; barcode bar-fields and sine curves structure the page
grammar.topology: Move by data column, by frequency band, and by frame index.
grammar.states: Scan, sample, and invert; selecting a column pulls its numbers into focus while the surrounding field drops to a faint bar pattern.
grammar.responsive: Columns thin and drop from the edges as width shrinks; reduced-motion disables all strobing and holds a single high-contrast still.

web: Render the barcode and sine lattice on canvas from a seeded sequence, stepping frames on requestAnimationFrame that halts entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Hand Processed Film Bloom
form: a hand-processed strip of 16mm film carrying scratches, uneven chemistry, and light leaks, where the emulsion itself joins the photographed event
spark: A runner crosses a gray field; orange light floods the perforations, scratches flash white, and the figure briefly dissolves into boiling grain.

grammar.palette: silver-gray emulsion over near-black leader as ground, orange light-leak flare reserved for the active frame, chemical sepia stains as wear
grammar.type: stamped edge-code caps and grease-pencil frame numerals along the sprocket margin, content banded in strict frame-by-frame rows
grammar.topology: Move between frame, strip, perforation, processing event, and photographed subject.
grammar.states: Expose, process, scratch, splice, and compare with latent, developing, fogged, damaged, and projected states.
grammar.responsive: Use selected frames and a user-controlled strip while providing transcript and visual descriptions.

web: Procedural film artifacts can be tied to exact frames and processing events rather than applied as a generic filter.

name: Coiled Earth Tower
form: a monumental earthen tower built from visible coils, where compression, drying, and hand pressure leave a slow ascending record
spark: Broad clay ropes circle upward above the maker's head, each thumb-smoothed seam catching a different band of late light.

grammar.palette: raw terracotta and umber coil bands as the ground, slip-white seams as dividers, one damp dark clay ring marking the course in progress
grammar.type: broad low-contrast slab caps like stamped brick marks, text banded in horizontal courses, each line's measure matching its coil
grammar.topology: Rise through courses while local joins, wall thickness, and overall silhouette remain connected.
grammar.states: Add, compress, brace, dry, and inspect with plastic, bearing, cracking, leather-hard, and fired states.
grammar.responsive: Convert the tower into an ordered vertical section and show construction growth only on request.

web: Incremental geometry can connect each course to time, maker action, and structural consequence without large assets.

name: Angura Theatre Poster
form: an underground theatre poster silkscreened in clashing flat color, a rising-sun ray burst behind collaged photographic heads, hand-drawn troupe lettering crammed into a border of dates and prices
spark: rays firing out from a point somewhere off to the left, three photographic heads pasted into the middle of them, and every last centimeter of the border packed with dates in lettering somebody drew by hand at two in the morning.

grammar.palette: flat screened vermilion, jade and cadmium yellow on white, printed dense enough that the inks sit slightly proud of the sheet
grammar.type: hand-drawn troupe lettering at the head, a ray burst radiating from one off-center point, dates and prices packed into a ruled border
grammar.topology: rays fan from a single origin, so navigation follows a ray outward to its billing rather than descending a list
grammar.states: controls are border cells, the active one floods vermilion, and past dates print as a struck rule inside the cell
grammar.responsive: the burst re-radiates from its origin at any aspect, and motion is a ray sweeping around the origin point

web: an svg ray burst that re-radiates responsive, border cells as navigation state, and a sweeping ray animation on transition

name: Well Traveled Passport
form: a well-traveled passport, where visa plates, entry stamps, and security paper accumulate into an involuntary autobiography of borders
spark: No two stamps align: purple ovals, faded dates, a full-page visa with a hologram bird, and your face getting older near the front.

grammar.palette: burgundy cover with a gold-blocked crest, guilloché-tinted security pages in rose and pale green, each border's stamp ink accumulating as the record
grammar.type: OCR-B machine lines anchoring the data page, engraved capitals on the cover, stamps landing at any angle over a ruled page grid that stays official
grammar.topology: chronological pages hold accumulated records; the document itself is identity plus history.
grammar.states: each grant occupies real page space with an official mark; renewals open a fresh booklet that references the old.
grammar.responsive: spreads become single pages on phones; new stamps land with one press, then stay still forever.

web: Verifiable stamp permalinks and printable pages make the record portable, with offline access to the booklet.

name: Depot Blind Courses
form: A monitoring surface built as a depot destination blind: bias-cut courses of dyed duck cloth stacked in a roll stepping under one fixed window, where anything wrong is the course stopped mid-step, showing two half-legends meeting across a single seam.
spark: A blind lifted onto the depot bench at 4:40 a.m. and lit from behind: green duck cloth halted between two courses, the top half of one destination and the bottom half of the next meeting at one seam, every thread glowing through the chrome-yellow letters.

grammar.palette: three dyes only: bottle-green duck cloth drenched, chrome-yellow legends, bleached calico carries all prose; foreign images are matted on cloth and never tinted.
grammar.type: one condensed grotesque, caps, one size; panels cut on a 12-degree bias, type level inside; rank is inversion: the lead panel alone prints dark on pale cloth.
grammar.topology: content rides a roll of stacked cloth courses that step under one fixed window inset from the trim; a punched eyelet tape down one edge is the index.
grammar.states: controls take no dye, only stitch, punch and relief; a fault stops its row mid-step, showing two half-legends over one seam; stale wears thin, dead bares the weave.
grammar.responsive: nothing glides; every change snaps one course, overshoots, settles; narrow screens drop courses, never shrink type; lit from behind so the weave stays visible.

web: Build the step for real: any changing cell is a strip translated in whole line-heights with a one-step overshoot, and a stalled half-step showing two clipped legends across a seam is the only error state.

name: Oscilloscope Signal Bench
form: a crt oscilloscope on a signal bench, phosphor trace riding an etched graticule while detented knobs set channel, timebase, and trigger
spark: You clip the probe to the pin and a green line snaps out of the noise; a nudge of the trigger knob and the waveform stands still, breathing in phosphor over the etched grid, ten divisions wide, every one meaning something.

grammar.palette: phosphor green blazing on near-black glass, graticule gray etched beneath, a second channel in dimmer trace; amber readouts for armed and warning states
grammar.type: condensed instrument caps on knob skirts and bezels, glowing seven-segment readouts; everything on screen is measured against the ten-division graticule
grammar.topology: one screen, many signals; you travel by timebase and vertical scale, and channels overlay in the same graticule space rather than separate views
grammar.states: detented knobs set scale and trigger level; an untriggered trace rolls free, a triggered one locks still, and freeze holds the waveform for cursors
grammar.responsive: the graticule stays square while readouts drop below on narrow screens; the sweep is continuous

web: canvas draws the persistent phosphor trace from live Web Audio or sensor input, with pointer-dragged trigger level and keyboard-stepped cursors

name: Exhibition Museum Curation Provenance Ribbon
form: a provenance ribbon, where ownership, extraction, exchange, repair, silence, and restitution fold through one object's life without becoming a bureaucratic table
spark: A red silk ribbon leaves a temple, disappears for forty years, reappears beneath a dealer's stamp, and splits at the present into display, return, and unresolved claim.

grammar.palette: archival buff as ground, one continuous red silk ribbon as the custody line, gaps rendered as gray unwoven thread, dealer stamps in fading ink
grammar.type: ledger serifs with dated small caps at every fold, known passages in solid type and inferred ones in hairline, one ribbon-led column
grammar.topology: Follow the ribbon through dated custody, geographic movement, gaps, and competing claims.
grammar.states: Open evidence at any fold, compare accounts, and distinguish known, inferred, and disputed passages.
grammar.responsive: Unroll the ribbon vertically on phones and keep uncertainty attached to every transition.

web: A citation-backed temporal graph, map projection, and revision history reveal provenance claims without implying certainty the evidence lacks.

name: Hand Drawn Zine Explainer
form: a hand-drawn technical zine on the web, where marker lettering, doodle arrows, and mascots teach a hard concept the way a friend sketches it on a napkin
spark: A cheerful marker headline sits above a doodled diagram, hand-drawn arrows looping from a wide-eyed mascot to a boxed code snippet, highlighter swipes marking the one line that matters as you step through the comic panels.

grammar.palette: cream paper ground, black marker ink, two or three flat highlighter accents in yellow, pink, and teal
grammar.type: a hand-lettered marker face for headings paired with a clean readable sans for body
grammar.topology: Move by stepping through numbered comic panels, by clicking mascot-guided call-outs, and by a sketched table-of-contents sidebar.
grammar.states: Hovering a doodle reveals its explanation; highlighter swipes animate across the active line; a mascot changes expression to mark done, warning, and gotcha states.
grammar.responsive: draw-on animation traces arrows in on scroll, and reduced-motion renders them already drawn.

web: Author diagrams as inline SVG with hand-drawn paths and animate the doodle arrows via stroke-dashoffset draw-on tied to scroll position.

name: Calendar Pinup Pad
form: an advertising wall calendar from a printing house, a painted figure filling the upper sheet and a tear-off date pad below carrying the merchant's name in gold-line lettering
spark: the top half is a painting somebody was paid real money for, the bottom half is twelve months of thin paper, and across the middle in gold script is the name of a hardware store that closed in 1968.

grammar.palette: warm painted flesh and saturated satin reds over a cream board, with a thin gold rule separating plate from pad
grammar.type: a script merchant line under the plate, a month name in condensed caps, and the date grid set small and even beneath it
grammar.topology: time is the only axis, and moving forward tears a leaf away to expose the next month against the same painted plate
grammar.states: controls are date cells, today takes a printed ring, past dates gray toward the board, and the pad thins as months go
grammar.responsive: the plate crops to a square on narrow frames while the pad stays legible, and motion is a single leaf tearing free

web: a date grid bound to live state, css transforms tearing the top leaf away, and responsive cropping of the painted plate

name: Aww2 Zoo Gardens Guide Map
form: a zoo and gardens guide map, where every area is a swelling lobe of flat colour and the coastline between lobes does all the dividing, and where a lobe can open in its middle so the page ground shows through it as water
spark: A summer opening-morning guide map creased into eight panels: an apple-green headland swelling across the fold, a coral flamingo standing right on its edge with one foot out over the cream, and a yellow capsule pinned to the coastline reading GATE.

grammar.palette: Flat unmodulated colour, no grain: green #8ED462 land on cream #F5F1E4 water, ink #2C2E2A. Photographs keep their own colour, cropped to a lobe, never tinted.
grammar.type: One grotesk at one weight; display at 0.95 leading, -0.06em. Prose is ink on cream, white, green or yellow; coral and blue carry labels only.
grammar.topology: One lobe dominates each screen, swelling until its coast leaves the frame on two sides; a lobe may open in its middle and let the ground through as water.
grammar.states: Controls are capsules in yellow #F5E211, coral #FF705D, blue #2BA0FF, lilac #EBC1FF; a round chip rides its trailing edge and crosses to the leading edge when live.
grammar.responsive: Everything that moves takes 0.4s and overshoots before settling. Scroll redraws the coastline continuously; at narrow widths the coast runs down the frame.

web: Every area is one SVG path; scroll advances a single timeline that morphs the coastline, and the same path clips the illustration and the type, so one geometry drives layout, art and state together.

name: Metro Typographic Tiles
form: a metro screen of flat tiles and giant lowercase, headlines cropped off the canvas edge, color fields as content, chrome deleted so the type itself is the interface
spark: you drag the panorama and the giant word music slides its cropped tail into view, a tile flips over in your peripheral vision with a new photo, everything black and cyan and nothing on screen that is not a word or a color

grammar.palette: flat cyan, magenta, or lime tiles on a pure black ground, zero gradients or bevels, white segoe as ink, one chosen accent color owns every live state
grammar.type: giant light-weight lowercase headlines cropped off the right edge, type ramped from caption to poster size, left-aligned on a strict grid of square tiles
grammar.topology: one wide panorama slides behind the viewport, pivot headers peek in from the next pane to promise more, tiles are the only doors
grammar.states: tiles tilt toward the finger on press, live tiles flip to show fresh data, selection floods a tile with the accent color, no borders or button chrome
grammar.responsive: the panorama collapses to a single tile column on narrow screens, entrances glide in from the edge with type leading

web: scroll-snap drives the panoramic panes; css 3d transforms tilt tiles on press and flip the live ones

name: Crouwel Grid Specimen
form: a Wim Crouwel gridded type specimen, where letterforms are built cell by cell on a visible construction grid and the poster is the proof
spark: Faint blue gridlines cover the sheet like graph paper; enormous letterforms assemble themselves from its cells, and one diagonal is the only rebellion the system permits.

grammar.palette: white or one stark saturated ground, faint construction-grid hairlines, one accent plane earned by the headline
grammar.type: monumental grid-constructed letterforms over small neutral grotesk; the layout grid stays visible as part of the design
grammar.topology: Move by cell, by letter, and by catalog entry.
grammar.states: Reveal construction, snap to cells, and toggle grid visibility as a real state.
grammar.responsive: The page reflows by whole cells; letterforms rebuild cell by cell when content changes.

web: CSS grid as the literal visible armature with display letterforms drawn from the same grid tokens

name: Editorial Sequence Montage Botanical Folio Season
form: a botanical folio following one plant through seed, leaf, flower, fruit, and winter husk, where each plate keeps the same exact scale and ground
spark: Five cream plates align on the same stem: a tight green bud opens scarlet, swells into black fruit, then remains as a dry silver cage.

grammar.palette: warm cream plate ground with hairline sepia rules, botanical greens and scarlet-to-black fruit as the only saturation, graphite gray for labels at rest
grammar.type: engraved italic species names over small-caps stage labels, five fixed-scale plates banded on one shared baseline with captions ranked beneath
grammar.topology: Move by life stage, date, plant part, plate detail, and recurring fixed landmark.
grammar.states: Align, overlay, compare, and annotate with dormant, emerging, flowering, fruiting, and senescent states.
grammar.responsive: Use registered overlays or a stage strip and provide descriptive change summaries.

web: Image registration can make subtle seasonal transformation directly comparable without automatic morphing.

name: Streaming Title Card Wall
form: a streaming catalog wall of horizontally scrolling rows, each poster tile expanding on focus to reveal a title, a rating chip and a short line, with the active row lifting slightly and the rest of the wall dimming behind it
spark: Rows and rows of artwork, and the one you land on grows and tells you what it is while everything else quietly gets out of the way.

grammar.palette: a deep neutral ground with full-bleed poster artwork as the only color, and a single accent on the focused tile border
grammar.type: rows of fixed-ratio poster tiles with a row heading above, and metadata revealed only inside the focused tile
grammar.topology: rows scroll horizontally and the wall scrolls vertically, so navigation is a grid traversed one axis at a time
grammar.states: controls are tiles, the focused one expands and reveals metadata, and the active row lifts while others dim
grammar.responsive: rows keep their tile ratio and show fewer per screen, and motion is a scale on focus with neighbors sliding aside

web: keyboard and pointer focus state driving tile expansion, horizontal rail scrolling with snap, and row-level dimming

name: Orienteering Map
form: an orienteering map and legend, iso-standard colors where white means runnable forest, contours rule the truth, and the course rides in purple over everything
spark: Thumb on the map and breath ragged, a runner in wet birch forest gambles on the marsh crossing because two contour lines pinch, and the purple line does not care how.

grammar.palette: isom inks, white runnable forest, olive thicket, yellow open land, brown contours, blue marsh, course purple reserved for the active leg

name: Struck Cathode Gauze

name: Japanese High Density Web

name: Webgl Shader Portal
form: the full-bleed portal of an experiential studio, where a GPU shader scene fills the screen and the interface floats as thin type over living pixels
spark: A full-screen shader breathes in slow color, a custom cursor trailing a soft distortion where it moves; a loader counts to one hundred, then thin uppercase links dissolve the mesh into the next scene as you click through.

name: Sleeping City Fold
form: a sleeping city fold, where streets crease into blankets, towers become bedposts, and neighborhoods dream different weather beneath one night
spark: At midnight an avenue rises like a quilt seam, apartment lights become embroidered stars, and a whole district folds gently over a park dreaming tropical rain.

grammar.type: soft rounded caps for district names stitched along seam lines, the map grid relaxing into blanket folds, morning notes set in a plain waking sans
grammar.topology: Move through waking streets, folded neighborhoods, shared dream edges, and morning return.
grammar.states: Tuck a district, open its dream, connect two sleeping weather patterns, and unfold at dawn.
grammar.responsive: Use layered city quilts on phones and substitute crossfades with static night and morning plates.

web: Deformable map geometry, local time, and collaborative dream fragments create a nightly city that remains spatially recognizable.

name: Brodovitch Bazaar Spread
form: a harper's bazaar spread under brodovitch, didot hairlines floating in white space, photograph and headline choreographed across the gutter like paired dancers

name: Matchbook Drawer
form: a drawer of hotel and club matchbooks, where foil scripts, tiny skylines, and phone numbers preserve nights out from vanished addresses

name: Gameboy Four Shade Field
form: a game boy field of four olive greens, 8 by 8 tiles, chunky dither standing in for every gradient, sprites readable as silhouette at postage-stamp size
spark: you tilt the slab toward the window to catch enough light, four greens resolving into a whole country, the blinking cursor waiting on your next press while the battery lamp burns its warning red

name: Riley Moire Gallery
form: a white gallery hung with black-and-white wave canvases, flat paint that flexes and strobes as visitors change their viewing distance
spark: The paintings hold perfectly still and yet the floor seems to tip, black lines swelling like a sea you can hear somewhere behind your own eyes.

grammar.palette: flat matte black and gallery white only, no mixed grays, contrast generated optically by line frequency, the tightest interval acting as the accent
grammar.type: a sparse neutral grotesk held clear of the waves in white margins, one caption per canvas, the composition itself a ruled monochrome field
grammar.topology: the room is a sequence of vantage distances; each canvas holds a near, mid, and far reading and rewards deliberate approach
grammar.states: state rides the pattern itself; line frequency tightens toward points that want attention and relaxes wherever nothing is asked

name: Mondo Tech Utopian Spread
form: an early-nineties technology magazine spread where fluorescent duotone swallows every element, photography and rules and boxes all printed in the same two impossible inks, angled headline slabs cutting the top third
spark: two inks that do not exist in nature, used for absolutely everything on the page including the box rules, with the headline slammed in at eleven degrees and the margin full of definitions.

grammar.palette: fluorescent orange and cyan as the only two inks in the entire system, applied to photography, rules, boxes and type alike
grammar.type: angled headline slabs breaking the top third, a three-column body, and glossary boxes stacked down the outer margin in the second ink

name: Fansite Shrine Page

grammar.palette: a small seamless tile repeating behind everything, saturated web-safe colors, and animated rules separating each section
grammar.type: a centered fixed-width table, headings as image banners, and every section closed by an animated divider bar
grammar.topology: the page is one long devoted column, so navigation scrolls through somebody's entire enthusiasm in their chosen order

name: Bollywood Painted Poster

name: Teen Magazine Quiz
form: a nineties teen-magazine quiz spread, lettered checkboxes marching down torn-edge photo collage, gel-pen doodles over halftone crushes, a verdict box waiting at the fold in pink and acid green

grammar.topology: decks rack in vertical rows nose-up; you browse by walking the wall, each board a full-height card, the top rail names the brand family

name: Rw Copy Shop Zine Interior

name: Kraftwerk Man Machine

name: Fly Posted Festival Hoarding Built
form: a screenprinted street-fair flyer pinned over an older one, cut-paper city stacked layer on layer, one word broken into a different flat colour per letter, a torn deckle edge running across the bottom and a clean white ticket panel floating on top of the art
spark: Every square inch is already occupied, so the only luxury left is one calm white panel and one word big enough to win. Colour is spent per letter, not per section; the grain of the print keeps the loudness handmade rather than glossy.

grammar.palette: gouache flats with riso grain, torn deckle edges, outlined flat figures, scribbles, stickers, no photography; cream #F3EDE0, ink #111, #FF6A00 #EE1F8A #7B57F0.
grammar.type: ultra-bold grotesk caps, 3 stacked lines, the middle word letter-per-colour (#F4451E #7B57F0 #3EA83E #1C7FE2); subline reversed on a brushed black bar.
grammar.topology: single full-bleed collage plane; white r20 finder card floats on it; torn-paper edge ends the field; #7B57F0 marquee repeats a word between circled chevrons.
grammar.states: nav 15px white caps top-right, active item #FF6A00; lime #C9E250 pill CTA, black caps; finder = 3 fields split by hairline dividers, round icons; no underlines.
grammar.responsive: marquee scrolls 60s linear; collage layers parallax .85/1/1.15x; badge spins 12s; big-word letters flip in 3.5s on load; stickers tilt 3deg to cursor, 0.25s

web: Continuous marquee bands, cursor-local sticker reactions and layered parallax let a static print collage keep breathing without ever reflowing the artwork.

name: Deco Cinema Lobby
form: an Art Deco cinema lobby at premiere hour, where stepped brass zigzags, sunburst marquees, and lacquered geometry frame velvet-roped anticipation
spark: Brass sunbursts fan over the doors, letters climb in stepped tiers, and every surface promises the feature has not started yet.

grammar.palette: lacquered ebony ground, champagne and brass gold for frames and body accents, velvet-rope crimson marking the primary action
grammar.type: high-waisted deco capitals with inline strokes climbing stepped marquee tiers, layouts mirrored about a center axis, sunburst rules fanning the headings
grammar.topology: arrival is staged as marquee, lobby, corridor, house; each threshold steps the geometry tighter.
grammar.states: primary actions get the sunburst frame; secondary actions recede into fluted panels.
grammar.responsive: stepped forms collapse tier by tier on small screens; light sweeps travel metal only on capable devices.

web: Gradient-mapped metallic surfaces and staged route transitions give each threshold a real arrival state.

name: Museum Exhibition Identity
form: a museum exhibition identity where one oversized cropped detail from a single work carries every surface, the title set small against it in a fixed corner, and dates and venue ruled into a consistent band at the foot of everything
spark: One corner of one painting, blown up until it stops being recognizable, with the exhibition title set politely small in the corner.

grammar.palette: the palette is taken entirely from the cropped artwork, with one neutral for the band and no color invented outside the work
grammar.type: a large cropped detail dominating, the title set small and locked to one corner, and a ruled band carrying dates and venue
grammar.topology: the same crop recurs across every surface, so navigation moves between applications rather than between images
grammar.states: controls are band items, the active one takes the artwork's dominant hue, and past dates strike within the band
grammar.responsive: the crop reframes to any aspect while keeping its focal detail, and motion is a slow push into the detail

web: art-directed responsive cropping around a declared focal point, palette extracted from the artwork, and a slow push-in

name: Flash Scrawl Club Sleeve
form: a french house label sleeve, a direct-flash party photograph defaced with a fat marker scrawl, the label logo redrawn by hand over the image and a fluorescent sticker slapped across one corner
spark: somebody took a flash photo of a room at four in the morning and then drew the label logo straight over the top of it in marker, badly, on purpose, and slapped a sticker in the corner.

grammar.palette: blown flash photography with crushed shadows, one fluorescent marker color scrawled over it, and a white sticker stock corner
grammar.type: a hand-scrawled logo sitting directly on the photograph, small pressed-type credits at the foot, and a sticker breaking one corner
grammar.topology: the sleeve is a defaced surface, so navigation adds another mark rather than opening a clean new view
grammar.states: controls are scrawl marks, the active one is redrawn heavier, and used ones stay on the surface as history
grammar.responsive: scrawls redraw to fit any crop, and motion is a marker stroke laid down at speed

web: svg marker paths drawn with stroke animation, persistent defacement state, and responsive scrawl repositioning

name: Endurance Livery Garage
form: an endurance-racing garage, Martini stripes and Gulf orange-over-blue run as portable identity systems across bodywork, number roundels and sponsor patchwork resolved into speed
spark: You stand in the garage at 3 a.m. as the 917 rolls in, powder blue and marigold under sodium light, and a mechanic wipes the roundel clean so the number reads for the night stint.

grammar.palette: Gulf powder blue with a marigold stripe, or white ground running Martini's light blue, dark blue and red bands, the white number roundel as focus state
grammar.type: sponsor logotypes gridded to panel lines, race numbers in heavy grotesk digits inside roundels, the stripe system reading identity before any word does
grammar.topology: stripes run nose to tail as the wayfinding spine; sections read as body panels, the roundel anchors each car's page and the pit board calls the lap
grammar.states: the live car carries the lit roundel, stints tick on the pit board, a sponsor panel dims when its system is cold and flares on activation
grammar.responsive: on narrow screens the stripe spine turns vertical and panels stack along it; changes streak with speed lines

web: css linear-gradient stripe systems persist across view transitions, carrying identity between pages
